byPath.*: Decides a prior authorization request of a health plan: authorization requirement, coverage, network, documents, diagnosis and step therapy
byPath.AuthRequest: A prior authorization request: the service, the diagnoses, the provider network, the documents, the member and the prior treatments
byPath.AuthRequestFacts: The date and time by which the payer must decide: 72 hours for urgent requests, 14 days otherwise
byPath.AuthorizationDecision: The verdict and the last day of the authorization
byPath.ClinicalReview: The diagnosis match, the step therapy trials and the missing documents
byPath.CoverageCheck: The medical policy of the service, whether it is known, whether an authorization is required and whether the member is covered
byPath.Member: The plan member: plan, birth date and coverage period; an open coverage has no end date
byPath.MemberFacts: The age of the member and whether the coverage includes the service date
byPath.PriorTreatment: A treatment that the member had before: therapy, start and end date, and outcome
byPath.PriorTreatmentFacts: The length of a treatment in days and whether it failed or was not tolerated
byPath.authorizationRequired: Whether the plan requires an authorization for the service
byPath.authorizationVerdict: Combines the checks into APPROVED, DENIED or PENDED, with a reason code, in the order of the review
byPath.authorize: Decides a request and returns the status, the reason, the checks, the validity and the deadline
byPath.biologicBook: A biologic drug for rheumatoid arthritis after a failed methotrexate trial
byPath.matchesIndication: Whether any diagnosis code starts with an indication prefix
byPath.medicalPolicy: The medical policy of each service: the indications as ICD-10 prefixes, the step therapy, the documents and the validity
byPath.mriBook: An urgent brain MRI that arrives without clinical notes
